response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), time_in_force_averages AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS time_in_force_average FROM matched GROUP BY timespan), order_averages AS (SELECT orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS order_average_fill FROM matched GROUP BY orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan), ranked AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.order_average_fill, oa.order_average_fill - ta.time_in_force_average AS excess_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oa.timespan ORDER BY oa.order_average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages AS oa JOIN time_in_force_averages AS ta ON oa.timespan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ta.timespan WHERE oa.order_average_fill > ta.time_in_force_average) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_average_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE fill_rank <= 3
